messages:
jordan (api): Heads-up — planning a coordinated push at 11:00 PT. Changes: api header-split, runtime kernel v2.3.4 (kv header tweak), router needs a transient compatibility variant. Need agreement on pin/unpin cadence and rollback gates. @marie @li @sam
marie (runtime): Runtime side: kernel bump modifies header encoding + KV prefix handling. We can be forward-compatible but need router to continue serving the old header format for ~30m after rollout. Propose router pin: 'legacy-keep-30m'.
li (router): We can do a transient variant. I'll create a pinned route (router:legacy-keep-30m) and an automated unpin script. Recommend sequence: canary -> staged -> full, keep pin until unpin script runs.
sam (console): Console depends on typed header schema. If router serves both variants for 30m, console can flip a feature flag at +15m after smoke pass. I'll prepare release notes and a migration snippet for frontend teams.
jordan (api): Rollback criteria proposal: any of these triggers immediate rollback — error rate >5% absolute or >3x baseline, p95 latency +50% vs baseline, or memory usage spike >70% on runtime nodes. Also prefer fast manual rollback button in deploybot.
marie (runtime): +1 to rollback gates. Canary plan: 3% traffic for 15m, then 20% for 10m, then ramp. Automatic rollback if any gate trips. Deploy command I'm going to use:
```
deploybot deploy --services api,runtime,router --versions v1.12.0,v2.3.4,v1.9.1 --canary 3% --pin router:legacy-keep-30m
```
li (router): Pin created and attached to the canary route. Unpin script path: /ops/scripts/unpin-router-1749991230.sh — it will wait 30m then remove the legacy variant.
sam (console): Drafting release notes now — will include console rollback steps and the feature-flag toggle timeline. I'll post to #release-notes in ~10m.
deploybot: deploybot: canary started — api@v1.12.0, runtime@v2.3.4, router@v1.9.1 (pinned). Canary window 15m. Logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/1749991230/logs
opsbot: opsbot: guardrail checks registered for p95 latency, error-rate, and memory. Notifications wired to oncall.
li (router): Observability: header-flip metric is streaming. Watching for mismatched client-schemas.
deploybot: deploybot: canary metrics: errors 0.05% -> baseline 0.05%, p95 +3% — within thresholds so far.
marie (runtime): Noted a sporadic timeout pattern hitting kv-prefetch in canary logs — tracking.
deploybot: deploybot: Alert — 11:05: timeout spike in runtime canary (1.2% of canary requests). Rolling metrics attached.
jordan (api): If it's isolated to a request pattern we can patch retry logic in runtime; prefer to avoid full rollback if safe. Marie — can you do a micro-patch to canary?
marie (runtime): Pushing a small retry / backoff tweak to canary now. Will monitor GC and kv cache hit-rate.
deploybot: deploybot: patch applied to canary. Re-evaluating for 5m.
sam (console): Holding unpin until patch is validated. Release note draft: https://docs.internal/releases/1749991230 (will post final once green).
opsbot: opsbot: scheduled unpin action at 1749993030 unless manual veto is posted in thread.
li (router): Thanks — I'll only execute unpin after confirmation from @sam + 2m buffer for metrics.
marie (runtime): Canary metrics now stable: timeout rate down to baseline, p95 within 10% of baseline. GC and memory look normal.
jordan (api): Good sign. Let's proceed with staged rollout once the 15m canary completes. Reminder: manual rollback command: `deploybot rollback --id 1749991230 --reason "timeout spike"`.
li (router): Standing by for unpin. I have the unpin script ready and a rollback route in case we need to traffic-shift back to legacy-only.
sam (console): All good from Console. I'm ready to flip the flag at +15m if no new anomalies. Release notes posted in #release-notes.
jordan (api): OK — proceeding to ramp sequence in 10m if no regressions. Thanks everyone for quick coordination.
li (router): Cheers — let me know if you want the unpin delayed.
marie (runtime): Monitoring dashboard: dashboards/internal/runtime/1749991230 — ping me if you see anything odd.
opsbot: opsbot: final note — oncall alerted and runbook linked: https://runbooks.internal/deploys/1749991230
jordan (api): thanks — locking this thread. If anyone vetoes, post here before 1749993030.
li (router): ack.
